checkers.name: Checkers
checkers.note: Online (Sixty60) price, which Checkers states matches in-store. Refreshed daily. Xtra Savings card deals shown separately.

shoprite.name: Shoprite
shoprite.note: Online price, refreshed daily. Xtra Savings card deals shown separately.

pnp.name: Pick n Pay
pnp.note: Online price for PnP's default pricing region. PnP allows one request every 10 seconds, early mornings only, so prices refresh on a rolling basis and each shows its date. Coverage grows every day.

woolworths.name: Woolworths
woolworths.note: Not available: woolworths.co.za blocks automated access. We do not bypass this.

spar.name: SPAR
spar.note: SPAR stores are independently owned and set their own prices; there is no online catalogue. We show SPAR's national specials (published as text on spar.co.za) and use them in basket totals where the barcode matches. Regional deals are in leaflets only.
